# background-size

Limit the number of steps in Feature and Rule Backgrounds.

| Category | Recommended | Safe autofix | Default options |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| structure | no | no | `{"maxSteps":5}` |

Limits Feature and Rule Background steps.
